strategy: Capture immutable source release identifiers, publication dates, download URLs, license text URLs, and checksums before ingest.
Refresh Overture monthly; process within the two-release public window and archive only rights-compatible derived artifacts.
Refresh Foursquare/SafeGraph only after license confirmation and record-level provenance tagging.
Refresh Texas/federal government layers per layer metadata; force manual review for stale, archived, HIFLD Secure, FOUO, sensitive, or unclear-license layers.
Run change detection for added, removed, renamed, relocated, category-changed, and duplicate records before any downstream registry patch.
Version destination source snapshots separately from the LP158 registry; LP159 does not activate or deploy data.
